text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Sigh, I'm at a loss. I don't know how to reply to Grandmother...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Where shall we go for our family
vacation? I just
can't think of any good
suggestions!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Well, we've recently been to Hong
Kong,
Dubai, and the UK...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The UK was fun. We could go there
again.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That won't do. As a Mejiro, I must not
fall back on
past favorites!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I was appointed this task directly by

Grandmother. It is a trial that I must
overcome!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: It is my duty to suggest a brand new destination that will surprise and delight her!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Or maybe she was just casually asking if
there's
anywhere you'd like to go...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Haha. That's so you, McQueen. You do
you!
